verdict: ALREADY PARTLY RUN (Nov 16-17 2026, deviation D6): 128 CZIs downloaded (529 GB) to the Modal volume and embedded; external MSI scored on 126 slides (UNI 0.665 [0.562-0.765], Phikon 0.760 [0.638-0.862]). WHAT IS LEFT: the KRAS arm has never been scored. 94 of the embedded slides are MMR-proficient with known KRAS (28 mutant / 65 wild-type) - an external MSS-restricted KRAS test at zero marginal cost, features already on the volume. Extending to the rest of SR386 (301 more cases, ~1,180 GB) would give 143 / 251 and narrow the CI from +-0.13 to +-0.06.
caveats: ZEISS CZI + OME-Zarr v0.5, not SVS/DICOM. 0.1112 um/px vs project 0.25 — needs 2.25x downsample. SR1482 includes biopsies and liver/lung metastases; SR386 (427 primary resections) is the clean subset. MMR-IHC is not MANTIS >=0.4 — label definition differs from project. Total byte size not measurable from the API (2,042 files); check before committing storage.
